title: Dose Right! — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Dosage calculation practice for CHEM 3A: build conversion-factor setups, draw up doses on syringes, work weight-based orders and safe ranges, set IV pumps and drip rates, use percent solutions and dilutions, and follow patient cases. Orders and limits are made up for math practice, and so are most drug names.
